patch_description: This design estimates how likely each direct link is to be selected by separately allocating two units of fractional capacity at each source and destination. Two-hop rewards then emphasize demand less likely to be served directly, while discounting transit through busy nodes and links with high direct demand. This endpoint-saturation estimate changes which paths receive reward rather than simply increasing every two-hop reward. A stronger degree penalty is intended to keep annealing samples feasible before repair.
